The monthly MACD is now deeper in negative territory than at any point since 2022 — a strong sign of exhaustion.  

Yet the macro environment is shifting positively:  

- ISM PMI is at 54, hitting a 4-year high.  
- Oil prices have fallen below $68.50, helping to ease inflationary pressure.  
- Labor market strength is returning, with job openings reaching a 2-year peak.

For momentum to shift, Bitcoin must retake the 200W MA at $62,648. Until then, sellers hold the upper hand.
